text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp starts today—a time for<n>students to
come together and hone<n>their running.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is all fired up for the<n>Shuka Sho, and
I'm hoping she can<n>further improve her skills at
camp!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling we're going to be<n>doing a lot of
sweating this summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I heard the temperatures are<n>going to be
even higher than last<n>year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, well, there's that, but... that's not<n>what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There you go again, Bright... Well,<n>let's make this a
good summer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's! We'll have to go for a<n>swim, grab food
from the beachside<n>stalls, have pillow fights, watch
fireworks, go to the festival...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you know I was talking about<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm here to prepare for the Kikuka<n>Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dober and Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's do this! We can do this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp with Mejiro Dober is<n>off to a
sweltering start!
